mapper.select: SELECT it.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, l.fnsku, l.title FROM ecom_inbound_item it LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = it.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = it.listing_id WHERE it.inbound_id = #{inboundId} ORDER BY it.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_inbound_item (inbound_id, material_id, seller_sku, qty, received_qty, unit_landed, remark, listing_id, sku_qty, part_main, plan_item_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.inboundId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.sellerSku}, #{i.qty}, #{i.receivedQty}, #{i.unitLanded}, #{i.remark}, #{i.listingId}, #{i.skuQty}, COALESCE(#{i.partMain}, 1), #{i.planItemId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT it.unit_landed FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id WHERE i.store_id = #{storeId} AND it.material_id = #{materialId} AND i.status IN ('SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED') AND it.unit_landed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.ship_date DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT it.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(it.qty - COALESCE(it.received_qty, 0)) AS qty FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id WHERE i.store_id = #{storeId} AND i.status = 'SHIPPED' GROUP BY it.material_id
